snippet.title: A Fistful Of Yankees | Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Get A Fistful Of Yankees now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936470/A_Fistful_Of_Yankees/ 

There is only one rule in the Wild West, the rule of the gun. Lead a fistful of Yankee soldiers on a mission to bring order to this chaotic frontier, facing desperados, robber barons, and more in a spaghetti western RTS adventure like no other.
